auth.loginDescription: Enter the administrator password to access the console.

enableWarning.title: Credentials required for {service}
enableWarning.message: This service requires credentials and none are configured. How do you want to proceed?

credentials.title: Credentials for {service}
credentials.signupPrompt: An account is required. Create one on the provider's site.
credentials.signupPasswordWarning: Create an account with a username or email address and a password. Sign-ins through Google or other OAuth providers are not supported.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Server configuration. Changes are applied to the running server without a restart.
settings.cacheBytesHint: Sizes in K (kilobytes). Empty or 0 restores the default (100 MiB disk / 32 MiB memory / 16 MiB block size).
settings.countryInvalid: The country must be exactly two uppercase letters (e.g., FR), or empty for automatic detection.
settings.cacheInvalid: Cache sizes must be non-negative integers.
settings.cacheBlockMultiple: The cache block size must be a positive multiple of 4 K.
settings.cacheBlockTooLarge: The cache block size must be smaller than the disk and memory cache sizes.
settings.saved: Settings saved. A restart is required to apply them.
settings.appliedHot: Settings saved and applied to the running server.
settings.redirectNotice: The server address changed. Redirecting to {url}…
settings.publicHttpWarning: Warning: Public network mode without HTTPS is insecure.
settings.localModeDisabled: Local mode is only available with elevated privileges.
settings.rootInvalid: Root must be a relative path with non-empty segments, for example arachnea or arachnea/admin.

adminPassword.title: Change Admin Password
adminPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
adminPassword.noPasswordSet: No permanent password set. Using temporary password from startup.

reload.reloadRequired: Changes applied. Please reload to activate.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The requested page does not exist.

config.loadFailed: The application configuration could not be loaded. The administration console requires a valid config.json file.

error.unauthorized: Session expired. Please log in again.
error.serverError: Server error. Please try again later.

summaries.network: The backend could not be reached. Check that the server is running.
